post.caption:
Lithium from Australia and South America, cobalt largely from Congo, rare earths mined in several countries and refined almost entirely in one, chips from Taiwan made on machines from a single Dutch company, assembly in Vietnam or India. The concentration risk sits in refining and fabrication, not mining, which is the part most coverage gets backwards. No country can build a modern phone alone.
